parameters.subject: ={{ $json.hrSubject }}
parameters.message:
=

Hi HR Team,

Manual Review Required: No personal email found in the candidate's CV.

Applicant Name: {{ $('Gmail Trigger').item.json.from.value[0].name }}
Relay Email: {{ $json.applicantRelayEmail }}
Original Subject: {{ $json.originalSubject }}

CV File: {{ $json.cvFileName }} ({{ $json.cvMimeType }})

Reason: {{ $json.reviewReason }}

Please open the original email and handle this application manually.

Message ID: {{ $('Gmail Trigger').item.json.messageId }}

Best regards,
Automation Team

values.content:
Read this CV PDF carefully, including visual text.

Extract only email addresses that are visibly present in the CV.

Return valid JSON only with this exact shape:
{
  "candidateEmail": string|null,
  "firstName": string|null,
  "allEmailsFound": string[],
  "emailSource": "cv_personal_email"|"indeed_relay"|"none",
  "confidence": number,
  "notes": string
}

Rules:
- Do not invent emails.
- candidateEmail must be one of allEmailsFound.
- Prefer a personal email from the CV.
- If no personal email exists but an Indeed relay email exists, use the Indeed relay email.
- Never choose emails from internal company domains.
- Return JSON only. No markdown.

filters.q: =in:anywhere from:me to:{{ $json.candidateEmail }} "We’re excited to learn more about you and what you’d like to contribute. Please visit our website to explore our current internship opportunities and complete the application for the role that best fits your background, interests, and goals."
